summary_short: Centene reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $53,579M, up 9.9% y/y, with net income of $1,091M swinging to a profit from a $253M loss a year earlier and diluted EPS of $2.19 versus a $0.51 per-share loss.
summary_long: Revenue of $53,579M rose 9.9% y/y and 7.3% q/q. EBITDA margin was 3.6%, down from 5.1% q/q but up from 0.5% a year earlier. Diluted EPS of $2.19 swung to a profit from a $0.51 per-share loss y/y, though it fell 29.6% q/q from $3.11. Net income of $1,091M swung to a profit from a $253M loss y/y. Cash and equivalents rose to $24,151M, up 66.4% y/y and 13.6% q/q.
